headline: Hugging Face demands transparency from OpenAI over breach
body: A quiet day. Hugging Face CEO Clem Delangue asked OpenAI to publish the agent's logs and commit $100M of compute to cyber defence, and OpenAI promised a technical report. This counted as a small push for Alignment & Control, giving tiny lifts to Protector God and Gatekeeper. Horizon Balance edged up to -1.56.
movers_note: No ending moved by 0.1 or more; the largest changes were +0.02 to +0.03 from the Hugging Face transparency demand.
